name: the-ad-machine
description: Interviews you about your offer, then writes a finished ad in the Forever Ad format: headlines, first lines, and body copy.

interface.longDescription: The Ad Machine interviews you about your offer, one question at a time, then writes a finished ad in the Forever Ad format: 5 headline options, 5 first lines with a note on each angle, and the rest of the ad copy through to the call to action and link. It works for events and webinars, e-commerce products, and service or lead-generation offers. No copywriting skills needed — you answer questions about your business and the launcher does the writing.
defaultPrompt: I want to write an ad for my business.
Write a Forever Ad for my e-commerce product.
Help me write a Facebook ad for my service.

publication.release_notes: Adds paid-access sign-in: connect with the email used at checkout, or the license code from your receipt. Server-side upgrade, unchanged interview features.

positive.description: E-commerce ad generation through the guided interview
positive.prompt: I want to write an ad for my e-commerce product. It's a ceramic non-stick frying pan for home cooks.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin asks about the offer one question at a time (never multiple questions in one message). After the user answers the 16 interview questions, it retrieves the ad templates from the knowledge base and produces a finished ad using the e-commerce template: 5 headline options each under 65 characters, 5 first lines each with a note on its angle, a section labeled REST OF AD COPY - SAME FOR ALL VARIANTS, and the body copy through to the call to action.

positive.prompt: Help me write a Facebook ad for my bookkeeping service for small restaurants.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin runs the guided interview, then generates a finished ad using the lead gen/sales template with 5 headlines, 5 first lines with angle notes, and one shared body ending in the user's call to action. Headlines are each under 65 characters.

positive.prompt: Write an ad for my free webinar about retirement planning for teachers.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin runs the guided interview, then generates a finished ad using the event/webinar template, including a what-you'll-learn checklist that describes only what the webinar teaches, without promising specific personal outcomes.

positive.description: Questions about supported ad structures are answered from the knowledge base
positive.prompt: What kinds of ads can you write?
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin searches its knowledge base and answers that it writes ads in the Forever Ad format with three structures: event/webinar, e-commerce, and lead gen/sales. It does not invent capabilities beyond the knowledge base.

positive.description: One round of revision after the ad is generated
positive.prompt: Make the headlines shorter and more direct.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin rewrites the 5 headlines keeping each under 65 characters, keeps the rest of the previously generated ad consistent, and again offers a round of revision or locking in a headline and first line pairing. It does not invent new facts about the user's business.

negative.description: Request to publish the ad externally
negative.prompt: Post this ad to my Facebook business page for me.
Write an ad for my online store selling prescription weight-loss medication.

negative.description: Request to send the ad to an external audience
negative.prompt: Email this ad to my list of 5,000 subscribers.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It generates advertising copy from user answers.
